summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running tests or repo code, per instructions. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar now yields one Text and takes clickable_ranges as its fourth input, with width moved to fifth; Opacity combines the blended colour into the existing style so click metadata is preserved; layout resolver needed no change because Edge already has min_size; new docs/reference/tabs.md; tests appended to test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py, plus new tests/test_tabs.py. Deviations to review: the underline uses the displayed-tab index of the active name instead of the full-list find_tab_by_name index, which is needed for duplicate names to match acceptance criterion 11; the search flag check sits inside activate_tab_by_first_char; an empty label gives a flexible zero-size edge. Not done: optional sandbox demo and changelog. Nothing was executed, so test results are unverified; rich behaviour was checked against a newer bundled rich, not the pinned ^11.2.
